text.autoconfig.simpletweaks.option.clai:
Server-side claims: /claim create claims your
chunk; only you and trusted players may change
it. Explosions, fire, fluids, pistons,
automation, mobs and tools respect claims. An
existing file keeps its value. Default: true.

Global per-player limit across dimensions.
Range 1–256. Existing claims are retained if
the limit is lowered. Default: 64.

Maximum trusted UUIDs per claim. Range 0–64.
Existing trusts are retained if the limit is
lowered. Default: 8.

Maximum total claims across dimensions. Range
1–10000. Existing claims are never silently
removed. Default: 4096.

Server ticks between successful claim, trust,
revocation or removal operations by one
player. Range 20–72000, across dimensions;
resets on restart. Default: 100 ticks.

Only operators at permission level 4 may
bypass protection when enabled. Does not
bypass claim caps, spawn or world-border
policy. Default: false.

Claims cannot intersect the world-spawn
square. Range 0–256; Vanilla spawn protection
is always respected. Default: 16 blocks.

Allowlist for new claims; "*" = every
dimension (default), or up to 32 dimension
IDs. Existing claims in other dimensions
remain protected. Entire chunks must be
inside the world border.
Default: all dimensions.
text.autoconfig.simpletweaks.option.admi: Block Log Only on Dedicated Servers

On: the block log runs on dedicated servers
only, not in single player or on LAN.
Off: it runs wherever it is enabled.
Default: true.

On: automatic backups and /backup now work
on dedicated servers only, not in single player
or on LAN. Off: they work wherever enabled.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpletweaks.option.prot: Anti-X-Ray Only on Dedicated Servers

On: ores are hidden on dedicated servers only,
not in single player or on LAN. Off: they are
hidden wherever anti-x-ray is enabled.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpletweaks.option.play:
Active players (online, not AFK, not spectating)
needed to start an event vote. Range 1–100.
The vote cooldown counts from the end of the
event. Default: 2.
text.autoconfig.simpletweaks.option.clai:
Players without rights may hit and shoot
monsters in foreign claims. Animals, vehicles
and decorations stay protected. Default: true.
Visitors May Take Their Own Items

Players without rights may pick up items they
dropped or threw themselves, also their own
death drops. Other items stay protected.
Default: true.

Players without rights may collect experience
orbs in foreign claims. Turn this off to protect
XP farms. Default: true.

A trident or arrow a claim refuses goes back to
the shooter exactly once (inventory, else at
their feet). Arrows that cannot be picked up
still vanish. Default: true.

simpletweaks.guide.page.1.title: Simple Tweaks
simpletweaks.guide.page.1: Legacy compatibility and server-authoritative claims, on by default.
simpletweaks.guide.page.2.title: Legacy World Compatibility
simpletweaks.guide.page.2: An exact whitelist resolves old item, block, block entity, and component names to existing SimpleBuilding registries.
simpletweaks.guide.page.3.title: Legacy World Compatibility
simpletweaks.guide.page.3: Saving uses the current names. No duplicate gameplay content is registered.
simpletweaks.guide.page.4.title: Claims (On by Default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.4: Server-authoritative claims, on by default: /simpletweaks claim create (or a legacy deed) claims the chunk you stand in;
simpletweaks.guide.page.5.title: Claims (On by Default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.5: only you and players you trust may build, break, open containers, use vehicles or take items there.
simpletweaks.guide.page.6.title: Claims (On by Default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.6: Explosions, fire, fluids, pistons, automation, projectiles, mob griefing, attractors and SimpleBuilding's area tools respect claims. Mobs still fight normally inside claims.
simpletweaks.guide.page.7.title: Claims (On by Default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.7: Server admins can switch claims off in config/simpletweaks-claims.json; an existing file keeps its value. Default: true.
simpletweaks.guide.page.8.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.8: Craft paper, an ink sac and honeycomb into an empty Claim Deed. Right-click it to claim the chunk you stand in; the deed is then bound to you.
simpletweaks.guide.page.9.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.9: A bound deed opens the map of your land; its Rights button opens the rights editor:
simpletweaks.guide.page.10.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.10: one line per person, a name or UUID, a colon, then the letters B Build, D Destroy, U Use, C Container, R Redstone, A Animals and vehicles, M Manage, or a role (@guest, @helper, @member, @manager). *: U gives every player a right;
simpletweaks.guide.page.11.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.11: [x,z] starts a section for one chunk. Done saves; the server checks the code again and answers with the line of every error. Copy a bound deed with an empty one in the crafting grid; a copy cannot be copied.
simpletweaks.guide.page.12.title: Claim Deed
simpletweaks.guide.page.12: Anybody else holding a deed sees the map only with a right in that land, otherwise only what they may do.
simpletweaks.guide.page.13.title: Old Claim Table
simpletweaks.guide.page.13: The claim table is gone: claims are seen on the wayfinder map (Simple Maps) and in the deed.
simpletweaks.guide.page.14.title: Old Claim Table
simpletweaks.guide.page.14: An old table left in a world turns into a Vanilla cartography table when you use it and throws out an empty Claim Deed (its recipe held one);
simpletweaks.guide.page.15.title: Old Claim Table
simpletweaks.guide.page.15: breaking it drops a cartography table and an empty deed, and placing an old table item sets a cartography table and gives you the empty deed.
simpletweaks.guide.page.16.title: Claims on the map
simpletweaks.guide.page.16: Claims are seen first on the wayfinder map of Simple Maps:
simpletweaks.guide.page.17.title: Claims on the map
simpletweaks.guide.page.17: with its Claims layer on, the map shows your own and other people's claims as colored strips on explored terrain, in every dimension. Simple Maps is recommended for claims.
simpletweaks.guide.page.18.title: Block and container log (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.18: Logs blocks players break or place, items taken from or put into containers,
simpletweaks.guide.page.19.title: Block and container log (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.19: sign edits, explosions and fire (hoppers optional), with actor, time, position and dimension.
simpletweaks.guide.page.20.title: Block and container log (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.20: /simpletweaks inspect shows a block's history, /simpletweaks lookup searches with filters,
simpletweaks.guide.page.21.title: Block and container log (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.21: /simpletweaks rollback undoes (with --preview), /simpletweaks restore redoes the last rollback.
simpletweaks.guide.page.22.title: Inventory backups on death (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.22: Before a player drops anything on death, their inventory, armor, offhand, XP, time, cause and position are saved; the last keep deaths (default 5, 1–50) per player stay.
simpletweaks.guide.page.23.title: Inventory backups on death (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.23: /simpletweaks deaths <player> [n] opens them in the admin inventory screen.
simpletweaks.guide.page.24.title: /simpletweaks invsee and /simpletweaks endersee (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.24: Own admin screen in the SimpleLib box style:
simpletweaks.guide.page.25.title: /simpletweaks invsee and /simpletweaks endersee (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.25: the target's armor, offhand, inventory and hotbar (or the ender chest) above your own inventory.
simpletweaks.guide.page.26.title: /simpletweaks invsee and /simpletweaks endersee (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.26: Items can be taken and put live; offline players work too.
simpletweaks.guide.page.27.title: Vanish (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.27: /simpletweaks vanish [player] makes an admin invisible to players below seePermission (default 2):
simpletweaks.guide.page.28.title: Vanish (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.28: not sent as an entity, left out of the tab list and the server list count and sample, no join or leave message.
simpletweaks.guide.page.29.title: Freeze (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.29: /simpletweaks freeze <player> holds a player in place: every move is set back, and breaking, using, placing, attacking and the drop key are refused. A title and an action bar line tell them;
simpletweaks.guide.page.30.title: Freeze (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.31.title: Restart announcements (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.31: Scheduled restart times (times, "HH:mm" in server time) and /simpletweaks restart <minutes> count down in chat at the warning minutes (default 15, 10, 5, 1) and at 30, 10…1 seconds, with a boss bar;
simpletweaks.guide.page.32.title: Restart announcements (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.32: at zero everything is saved and the server stops cleanly.
simpletweaks.guide.page.33.title: Automatic world backups (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.33: Every intervalHours (default 6, 1–168) and with /simpletweaks backup now the world is zipped like save-off, save-all flush, save-on:
simpletweaks.guide.page.34.title: Automatic world backups (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.34: saving pauses, everything is flushed, a worker thread writes the archive, then saving resumes.
simpletweaks.guide.page.35.title: Maintenance mode (switch on, mode off)
simpletweaks.guide.page.35: /simpletweaks maintenance on lets only operators of joinPermission (default 2) and the names or UUIDs in allowed join; everybody else gets kickMessage.
simpletweaks.guide.page.36.title: Maintenance mode (switch on, mode off)
simpletweaks.guide.page.36: The server list shows motd. /simpletweaks maintenance off ends it, /simpletweaks maintenance status tells.
simpletweaks.guide.page.37.title: Lag finder (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.37: /simpletweaks lag [seconds] (default 5, 1–30) measures tick time and TPS, time per block entity type and entity type,
simpletweaks.guide.page.38.title: Lag finder (on by default)
simpletweaks.guide.page.38: the most expensive chunks with their entity and block entity counts, and hints at possible redstone clocks.
simpletweaks.guide.page.39.title: Share coordinates
simpletweaks.guide.page.39: /simpletweaks coords [message] shares your position with everybody, /simpletweaks coords to <player> [message] with one player.
simpletweaks.guide.page.40.title: Private death hint
simpletweaks.guide.page.40: After a real death only you get a line with place (copy on click), dimension, cause and how long your items stay (5 minutes while the area is loaded).
simpletweaks.guide.page.41.title: Chat mentions
simpletweaks.guide.page.41: @Name in chat is highlighted in yellow for everybody, and the mentioned players hear a soft bell.
simpletweaks.guide.page.42.title: /simpletweaks playtime and /simpletweaks seen
simpletweaks.guide.page.42: /simpletweaks playtime [player] shows the play time from the Vanilla statistics; /simpletweaks seen <player> says whether a player is online or how long ago they left.
simpletweaks.guide.page.43.title: Mob griefing per mob
simpletweaks.guide.page.43: Listed mobs (blocked, default creeper, enderman, ghast, wither, ravager) cannot change blocks; all other mobs follow the Vanilla rule mob_griefing.
simpletweaks.guide.page.44.title: PvP per player
simpletweaks.guide.page.44: /simpletweaks pvp on|off (no argument: status). A player can hurt another only when both have PvP on.
simpletweaks.guide.page.45.title: Newcomer protection
simpletweaks.guide.page.45: New players take and deal no PvP damage during their first minutes (default 5) of online play time in this world; then PvP works as usual again.
simpletweaks.guide.page.46.title: Welcome and announcements
simpletweaks.guide.page.46: A welcome line for joining players ({player} is replaced), rotating tips every tipMinutes and own join/leave lines instead of the Vanilla ones.
simpletweaks.guide.page.47.title: Daily login reward
simpletweaks.guide.page.47: The first join of a day gives the reward items; days in a row build a streak, a gap starts again at 1, and every bonusEvery days (default 7) there are bonus items.
simpletweaks.guide.page.48.title: Server events
simpletweaks.guide.page.48: Operators start events with /simpletweaks event start <double_xp|more_loot|blood_moon> [minutes], stop and status; one event at a time with a boss bar.
simpletweaks.guide.page.49.title: Leaderboard
simpletweaks.guide.page.49: /simpletweaks leaderboard <playtime|deaths|kills|mined> lists the top 10 of every player known to the server.
simpletweaks.guide.page.50.title: Votes
simpletweaks.guide.page.50: /simpletweaks vote weather clear and /simpletweaks vote event <name> start a vote with clickable Yes/No; /simpletweaks vote yes|no counts.
simpletweaks.guide.page.51.title: AFK detection
simpletweaks.guide.page.51: After minutes (default 5) without any action, or with /simpletweaks afk, a player is AFK: gray with [AFK] in the tab list and not counted for sleeping.
simpletweaks.guide.page.52.title: World border per dimension
simpletweaks.guide.page.52: Entries in border.dimensions (size and center per dimension) are applied to that dimension's world border at server start; /simpletweaks border lists all borders.
simpletweaks.guide.page.53.title: Nether roof lock
simpletweaks.guide.page.53: Survival and adventure players above Y 127 in the Nether are put back below the roof (last place below it, or a free spot under it).
simpletweaks.guide.page.54.title: Partial keep inventory
simpletweaks.guide.page.54: While the Vanilla rule keep_inventory is off, part of the inventory stays on death: hotbar_armor (hotbar, armor, offhand), xp (experience) or custom (switches per part and keepXpPercent).
simpletweaks.guide.page.55.title: Dragon egg every fight
simpletweaks.guide.page.55: Every later dragon kill puts a new dragon egg on the exit portal; if an egg already lies there, it drops as an item.
simpletweaks.guide.page.56.title: Phantoms per player
simpletweaks.guide.page.56: /simpletweaks phantoms off stops phantoms from spawning for you; /simpletweaks phantoms on brings them back.
simpletweaks.guide.page.57.title: Mob limit per chunk
simpletweaks.guide.page.57: Every scanSeconds the mobs per chunk are counted; over perChunk (default 50) the claim owner or nearby players and operators get a message.
simpletweaks.guide.page.58.title: Ground item cleanup
simpletweaks.guide.page.58: Every intervalMinutes (default 15) ground items are cleared after a chat countdown; /simpletweaks cleanup now starts it at once (operators).
simpletweaks.guide.page.59.title: Chunk pregeneration
simpletweaks.guide.page.59: /simpletweaks pregen start <radius> [dimension] generates every chunk around the world border center; pause, resume, stop and status (operators of level 3).
simpletweaks.guide.page.60.title: Automatic off with partner mods (autoOffWith)
simpletweaks.guide.page.60: A feature switches itself off at server start when a mod that does the same job is loaded:
simpletweaks.guide.page.61.title: Automatic off with partner mods (autoOffWith)
simpletweaks.guide.page.61: Ledger or MineTracer for the block log, InvRestore for death backups, Inv View for /invsee,
simpletweaks.guide.page.62.title: Automatic off with partner mods (autoOffWith)
simpletweaks.guide.page.62: Chunky for pregeneration, Litematica or Axiom for the action checks. Freecam only gets a log note.
simpletweaks.guide.page.63.title: Creative tabs
simpletweaks.guide.page.63: The module's items sit in its own creative tab only (no Vanilla tabs).
simpletweaks.guide.page.64.title: Anti-X-Ray
simpletweaks.guide.page.64: Ores that touch no air, water or other see-through block are sent to players as their host stone (stone, deepslate, netherrack, end stone), so x-ray texture packs, x-ray mods and noclip cameras see no hidden ore.
simpletweaks.guide.page.65.title: Anti-X-Ray
simpletweaks.guide.page.66.title: Freecam rule
simpletweaks.guide.page.66: When the server turns it on (freecam.enabled, default off), players with the Freecam mod may still fly the camera, but not through blocks:
simpletweaks.guide.page.67.title: Freecam rule
simpletweaks.guide.page.67: Simple Tweaks on the client forces Freecam's block collision while connected to that server.
simpletweaks.guide.page.68.title: Further protections
simpletweaks.guide.page.68: Three more switches, each off by default:
simpletweaks.guide.page.69.title: Further protections
simpletweaks.guide.page.69: seedHash sends a random hashed seed to clients, hideHealth sends other players' health as their maximum,
simpletweaks.guide.page.70.title: Further protections
simpletweaks.guide.page.70: actionChecks reports reach and fast-break attempts to operators (no automatic punishment).
simpletweaks.guide.page.71.title: Commands
simpletweaks.guide.page.71: /simpletweaks config shows and changes every option of config/simpletweaks-play.json, -admin.json, -protect.json and -claims.json in one tree: play.*, admin.*, protect.*, claims.* (list [group], get, set, reset, help;
simpletweaks.guide.page.72.title: Commands
simpletweaks.guide.page.72: Tab completes options and values). Values are bounded like in the files and saved at once; play, admin and protect take effect at once, claims.* needs a restart. Permission level 2.
